checks: pinned upstream export: plan, import and exact source coverage
attributed review, reject, atomic correction and current-only recall
changed-source reconciliation is read-only and preserves the correction
SQLite to Markdown: identity, review, source coverage and retained Git revisions
rollback into a fresh SQLite store preserves the reviewed correction and Git history
limitations: Synthetic upstream serializer fixture only. Source coverage is not acceptance or retrieval quality. No live claude-mem data/settings changed; rollback restores MemoryKit, not the upstream database. Credentials and operation replay are excluded from archives.
